θαδδαιοσ.def: of uncertain origin; Thaddæus, one of the Apostles. KJV: Thaddæus.

θαλασσα.def: probably prolonged from ἅλς (G251); the sea (genitive case or specially). KJV: sea.

θαλπω.def: probably akin to θάλλω (to warm); to brood, i.e. (figuratively) to foster. KJV: cherish.

θαμαρ.def: of Hebrew origin (H8559); Thamar (i.e. Tamar), an Israelitess. KJV: Thamar.

θαμβεω.def: from θάμβος (G2285); to stupefy (with surprise), i.e. astound. KJV: amaze, astonish.

θαμβοσ.def: akin to an obsolete τάφω (to dumbfound); stupefaction (by surprise), i.e. astonishment. KJV: X amazed, + astonished, wonder.

θανασιμοσ.def: from θάνατος (G2288); fatal, i.e. poisonous. KJV: deadly.

θανατηφοροσ.def: from (the feminine form of) θάνατος (G2288) and φέρω (G5342); death-bearing, i.e. fatal. KJV: deadly.

θανατοσ.def: from θνήσκω (G2348); (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or figuratively). KJV: X deadly, (be…) death.

θανατοω.def: from θάνατος (G2288) to kill (literally or figuratively). KJV: become dead, (cause to be) put to death, kill, mortify.

θαπτω.def: a primary verb; to celebrate funeral rites, i.e. inter. KJV: bury.

θαρα.def: of Hebrew origin (H8646); Thara (i.e. Terach), the father of Abraham. KJV: Thara.

θαρρεω.def: another form for θαρσέω (G2293); to exercise courage. KJV: be bold, X boldly, have confidence, be confident.

θαρσεω.def: from θάρσος (G2294); to have courage. KJV: be of good cheer (comfort).

θαρσοσ.def: akin (by transposition) to θράσος (daring); boldness (subjectively). KJV: courage.

θαυμα.def: apparently from a form of θεάομαι (G2300); wonder (properly concrete; but by implication, abstract). KJV: admiration.

θαυμαζω.def: from θαῦμα (G2295); to wonder; by implication, to admire. KJV: admire, have in admiration, marvel, wonder.

θαυμασιοσ.def: from θαῦμα (G2295); wondrous, i.e. (neuter as noun) a miracle. KJV: wonderful thing.

θαυμαστοσ.def: from θαυμάζω (G2296); wondered at, i.e. (by implication) wonderful. KJV: marvel(-lous).

θεα.def: feminine of θεός (G2316); a female deity. KJV: goddess.

θεαομαι.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb; to look closely at, i.e. (by implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to visit. KJV: behold, look (upon), see.

θεατριζω.def: from θέατρον (G2302); to expose as a spectacle. KJV: make a gazing stock.

θεατρον.def: from θεάομαι (G2300); a place for public show ("theatre"), i.e. general audience-room; by implication, a show itself (figuratively). KJV: spectacle, theatre.

θειον.def: probably neuter of θεῖος (G2304) (in its original sense of flashing); sulphur. KJV: brimstone.

θειοσ.def: from θεός (G2316); godlike (neuter as noun, divinity). KJV: divine, godhead.

θειωδησ.def: from θεῖον (G2303) and 1491; sulphur-like, i.e. sulphurous. KJV: brimstone.

θελημα.def: from the prolonged form of θέλω (G2309); a determination (properly, the thing), i.e. (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree; abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination. KJV: desire, pleasure, will.

θελησισ.def: from θέλω (G2309); determination (properly, the act), i.e. option. KJV: will.

θελω.def: apparently strengthened from the alternate form of αἱρέομαι (G138); to determine (as an active option from subjective impulse; whereas βούλομαι (G1014) properly denotes rather a passive acquiescence in objective considerations), i.e. choose or prefer (literally or figuratively); by implication, to wish, i.e. be inclined to (sometimes adverbially, gladly); impersonally for the future tense, to be about to; by Hebraism, to delight in. KJV: desire, be disposed (forward), intend, list, love, mean, please, have rather, (be) will (have, -ling, - ling(-ly)).

θεμελιοσ.def: from a derivative of τίθημι (G5087); something put down, i.e. a substruction (of a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively). KJV: foundation.

θεμελιοω.def: from θεμέλιος (G2310); to lay a basis for, i.e. (literally) erect, or (figuratively) consolidate. KJV: (lay the) found(- ation), ground, settle.

θεοδιδακτοσ.def: from θεός (G2316) and διδάσκω (G1321); divinely instructed. KJV: taught of God.

θεομαχεω.def: from θεομάχος (G2314); to resist deity. KJV: fight against God.

θεομαχοσ.def: from θεός (G2316) and μάχομαι (G3164); an opponent of deity. KJV: to fight against God.

θεοπνευστοσ.def: from θεός (G2316) and a presumed derivative of πνέω (G4154); divinely breathed in. KJV: given by inspiration of God.

θεοσ.def: of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with ὁ (G3588)) the supreme Divinity; figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very. KJV: X exceeding, God, god(-ly, -ward).

θεοσεβεια.def: from θεοσεβής (G2318); devoutness, i.e. piety. KJV: godliness.

θεοσεβησ.def: from θεός (G2316) and σέβομαι (G4576); reverent of God, i.e. pious. KJV: worshipper of God.

θεοστυγησ.def: from θεός (G2316) and the base of στυγνητός (G4767); hateful to God, i.e. impious. KJV: hater of God.

θεοφιλοσ.def: from θεός (G2316) and φίλος (G5384); friend of God; Theophilus, a Christian. KJV: Theophilus.

θεραπεια.def: from θεραπεύω (G2323); attendance (specially, medical, i.e. cure); figuratively and collectively, domestics. KJV: healing, household.

θεραπευω.def: from the same as θεράπων (G2324); to wait upon menially, i.e. (figuratively) to adore (God), or (specially) to relieve (of disease). KJV: cure, heal, worship.

θεραπων.def: apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the base of θέρος (G2330); a menial attendant (as if cherishing). KJV: servant.

θεριζω.def: from θέρος (G2330) (in the sense of the crop); to harvest. KJV: reap.

θερισμοσ.def: from θερίζω (G2325); reaping, i.e. the crop. KJV: harvest.

θεριστησ.def: from θερίζω (G2325); a harvester. KJV: reaper.

θερμαινω.def: from θέρμη (G2329); to heat (oneself). KJV: (be) warm(-ed, self).

θερμη.def: from the base of θέρος (G2330); warmth. KJV: heat.

θεροσ.def: from a primary θέρω (to heat); properly, heat, i.e. summer. KJV: summer.

θεσσαλονικευσ.def: from Θεσσαλονίκη (G2332); a Thessalonican, i.e. inhabitant of Thessalonice. KJV: Thessalonian.

θεσσαλονικη.def: from Θεσσαλός (a Thessalian) and νίκη (G3529); Thessalonice, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Thessalonica.

θευδασ.def: of uncertain origin; Theudas, an Israelite. KJV: Theudas.

θεωρεω.def: from a derivative of θεάομαι (G2300) (perhaps by addition of ὁράω (G3708)); to be a spectator of, i.e. discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or intensively (acknowledge)). KJV: behold, consider, look on, perceive, see.

θεωρια.def: from the same as θεωρέω (G2334); spectatorship, i.e. (concretely) a spectacle. KJV: sight.

θηκη.def: from τίθημι (G5087); a receptacle, i.e. scabbard. KJV: sheath.

θηλαζω.def: from θηλή (the nipple); to suckle, (by implication) to suck. KJV: (give) suck(-ling).

θηλυσ.def: from the same as θηλάζω (G2337); female. KJV: female, woman.

θηρα.def: from θήρ (a wild animal, as game); hunting, i.e. (figuratively) destruction. KJV: trap.

θηρευω.def: from θήρα (G2339); to hunt (an animal), i.e. (figuratively) to carp at. KJV: catch.

θηριομαχεω.def: from a compound of θηρίον (G2342) and μάχομαι (G3164); to be a beast-fighter (in the gladiatorial show), i.e. (figuratively) to encounter (furious men). KJV: fight with wild beasts.

θηριον.def: diminutive from the same as θήρα (G2339); a dangerous animal. KJV: (venomous, wild) beast.

θησαυριζω.def: from θησαυρός (G2344); to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively). KJV: lay up (treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up).

θησαυροσ.def: from τίθημι (G5087); a deposit, i.e. wealth (literally or figuratively). KJV: treasure.

θιγγανω.def: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary θίγω (to finger); to manipulate, i.e. have to do with; by implication, to injure. KJV: handle, touch.

θλιβω.def: akin to the base of τρίβος (G5147); to crowd (literally or figuratively). KJV: afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble.

θλιψισ.def: from θλίβω (G2346); pressure (literally or figuratively). KJV: afflicted(-tion), anguish, burdened, persecution, tribulation, trouble.

θνησκω.def: a strengthened form of a simpler primary θάνω (which is used for it only in certain tenses); to die (literally or figuratively). KJV: be dead, die.

θνητοσ.def: from θνήσκω (G2348); liable to die. KJV: mortal(-ity).

θορυβεω.def: from θόρυβος (G2351); to be in tumult, i.e. disturb, clamor. KJV: make ado (a noise), trouble self, set on an uproar.

θορυβοσ.def: from the base of θροέω (G2360); a disturbance. KJV: tumult, uproar.

θραυω.def: a primary verb; to crush. KJV: bruise.

θρεμμα.def: from τρέφω (G5142); stock (as raised on a farm). KJV: cattle.

θρηνεω.def: from θρῆνος (G2355); to bewail. KJV: lament, mourn.

θρηνοσ.def: from the base of θροέω (G2360); wailing. KJV: lamentation.

θρησκεια.def: from a derivative of θρησκός (G2357); ceremonial observance. KJV: religion, worshipping.

θρησκοσ.def: probably from the base of θροέω (G2360); ceremonious in worship (as demonstrative), i.e. pious. KJV: religious.

θριαμβευω.def: from a prolonged compound of the base of θροέω (G2360); and a derivative of ἅπτομαι (G680) (meaning a noisy iambus, sung in honor of Bacchus); to make an acclamatory procession, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer or (by Hebraism) to give victory. KJV: (cause) to triumph (over).

θριξ.def: genitive case τριχός, etc.; of uncertain derivation; hair. KJV: hair.

θροεω.def: from θρέομαι to wail; to clamor, i.e. (by implication) to frighten. KJV: trouble.

θρομβοσ.def: perhaps from τρέφω (G5142) (in the sense of thickening); a clot. KJV: great drop.

θρονοσ.def: from θράω (to sit); a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power or (concretely) a potentate. KJV: seat, throne.

θυατειρα.def: of uncertain derivation; Thyatira, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Thyatira.

θυγατηρ.def: apparently a primary word (compare "daughter"); a female child, or (by Hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant). KJV: daughter.

θυγατριον.def: from θυγάτηρ (G2364); a daughterling. KJV: little (young) daughter.

θυελλα.def: from θύω (G2380) (in the sense of blowing) a storm. KJV: tempest.

θυινοσ.def: from a derivative of θύω (G2380) (in the sense of blowing; denoting a certain fragrant tree); made of citron-wood. KJV: thyine.

θυμιαμα.def: from θυμιάω (G2370); an aroma, i.e. fragrant powder burnt in religious service; by implication, the burning itself. KJV: incense, odour.

θυμιαστηριον.def: from a derivative of θυμιάω (G2370); a place of fumigation, i.e. the alter of incense (in the Temple). KJV: censer.

θυμιαω.def: from a derivative of θύω (G2380) (in the sense of smoking); to fumigate, i.e. offer aromatic fumes. KJV: burn incense.

θυμομαχεω.def: from a presumed compound of θυμός (G2372) and μάχομαι (G3164); to be in a furious fight, i.e. (figuratively) to be exasperated. KJV: be highly displeased.

θυμοσ.def: from θύω (G2380); passion (as if breathing hard). KJV: fierceness, indignation, wrath.

θυμοω.def: from θυμός (G2372); to put in a passion, i.e. enrage. KJV: be wroth.

θυρα.def: apparently a primary word (compare "door"); a portal or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively). KJV: door, gate.

θυρεοσ.def: from θύρα (G2374); a large shield (as door-shaped). KJV: shield.

θυρισ.def: from θύρα (G2374); an aperture, i.e. window. KJV: window.

θυρωροσ.def: from θύρα (G2374) and οὖρος (a watcher); a gate- warden. KJV: that kept the door, porter.

θυσια.def: from θύω (G2380); sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively). KJV: sacrifice.

θυσιαστηριον.def: from a derivative of θυσία (G2378); a place of sacrifice, i.e. an altar (special or genitive case, literal or figurative). KJV: altar.

θυω.def: a primary verb; properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e. (by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case); by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose). KJV: kill, (do) sacrifice, slay.

θωμασ.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H8380); the twin; Thomas, a Christian. KJV: Thomas.

θωραξ.def: of uncertain affinity; the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a corslet. KJV: breast-plate.
